quests.name: A Long-Awaited Invitation
objectives: Hades and Maleficent refuse to make peace.
Talk to the Lorekeeper for advice.
Reorder "The Spark of Spite" in the Lorekeeper's pages.
Talk to The Lorekeeper.

Gather the materials for the invitations:
  ‧ 3 Fuchsia Eternal Poppies.
  ‧ 3 Pink Rose.
  ‧ 12 Petrified Wood.
  ‧ 14 Fairy Bubbles.
  ‧ 14 Lightning Spice.
Craft the 2 Neverafter Council Invitations.

Invite the villainous pair to the gathering:
  ‧ Deliver the invitation to Maleficent in her castle.
  ‧ Make sure Maleficent's invitation is in your Inventory.
  ‧ Deliver the invitation to Hades.
  ‧ Make sure Hades' invitation is in your Inventory.
Talk to the Lorekeeper when you're ready to start the meeting.
Watch as the Mistress of All Evil and the Lord of the Underworld finally meet.

Maleficent has vanished!
  ‧ Talk to the Lorekeeper.
  ‧ Talk to Hades.

quests.name: A Storm of Stories
objectives: Claim the content message titled "A most disturbing development!" from your mailbox when you're ready to begin your next adventure.
The Lorekeeper sent you a message explaining some disastrous developments.
Talk to The Lorekeeper.
A Story Sickness is afflicting the residents of the Vale.
Talk to Merida to uncover its cause.
Follow Merida to the mysterious whirlwind in the Bind.
Strange new Snippets have appeared!
Catch the Shadowy Bird Snippets. (5)
Something mysterious and glittering came out of the whirlwind...
Pick up the Mysterious Story Page.
Make sure you have the Mysterious Story Page in your Inventory.
Bring the Mysterious Story Page to Merida.
Continue investigating the strange happenings around the Vale.
Talk to Flynn.
(Optional) Catch more Shadowy Bird Snippets and complete new stories in the Lorekeeper's pages
Winnie the Pooh
Follow Flynn to the mysterious whirlwind in Everafter.
Talk to Flynn.
Catch the Shadowy Frog Snippets. (5)
A page has appeared from the whirlwind!
Pick up Flynn's moment.
Make sure you have the Anchor Moment in your Inventory.
Bring the Anchor Moment to Flynn.
Continue investigating the phenomena in the Storybook Vale.
Talk to Hades.
(Optional) Catch more Shadowy Frog Snippets and complete new Tales in the Lorekeeper's pages:
Snow White.
Follow Hades to the mysterious whirlwind in Mythopia.
Catch the Shadowy Demon Snippets that emerged from the Story Storm. (5)
Another mysterious page emerged from the whirlwind!
Collect Hades' Story Page.
Make sure you have the Story Page in your Inventory.
Bring the Story Page to Hades.
Talk to the Lorekeeper.
Complete "Maleficent's Journey" in the Lorekeeper's pages to discover what happened to Maleficent.
Talk to the Lorekeeper about what you saw in the story.
Figure out how to arrange the tiles on the floor in the Library of Lore to pass into the Unwritten Realms.
Enter the Unwritten Realms.

quests.name: A Hero of Ink and Paper
objectives: The Lorekeeper was the last person who saw Aurora.
Talk to the Lorekeeper.
Interact with the tapestry behind the Lorekeeper.
Well, that didn't work...
Talk to the Lorekeeper.
Find Aurora's Notes in the secret chamber beneath the bridge in the Bind.

Search the Vale for the pieces of the Fairy Tale Book:
  ‧ Near the Fallen Fortress's crumbling walls.
  ‧ Near a windmill in Mythopia.
Bring all the volumes of the Fairy Tale Book back to the Lorekeeper.

Talk to the following Villagers:
  ‧ Maleficent.
  ‧ Hades.
  ‧ Flynn.
  ‧ Merida.

Gather the following materials:
  ‧ Yellow Tale Cone Flowers. (4)
  ‧ Blue Tale Cone Flower. (4)
  ‧ Olive Green Tale Cone Flower. (4)
  ‧ Beige Tale Cone Flower. (4)
  ‧ Posidonia. (10)
  ‧ Blue Bird Snippet. (4)
  ‧ Red Demon Snippet. (4)
  ‧ Green Frog Snippet. (4)
Craft the "Hero of the Vale" Costume at a Crafting Station.
Make sure the "Hero of the Vale" Costume is in your Inventory.
Bring the "Hero of the Vale" Costume to the Lorekeeper.
Put on the Hero of the Vale Coat.
Interact with the tapestry in the center of the Library of Lore.
